data.description:
Placeholder for the deeper-signal extension of test creation calibration metrics. Sibling of 7f42-e41f (which delivers (a) manifest-claim breadth + (a+) static header-vs-source-import check in its first version) and 411b-a047 (mutation infrastructure / Tier 3).

Scope: extends 7f42's first-version metric set with two stronger signals:

## (b) Intent-anchored line coverage

For each changed source line in a PR, compute the percentage exercised by tests whose intent-claim header (per d566's Rule 6) references an intent_id from the PR's parent ticket subtree (per 94ed's manifest). Requires polyglot per-test line-coverage infrastructure (coverage.py + pytest-cov for Python; bashcov or trace-harness for bash; istanbul/nyc for JS/TS if present), per-test attribution storage, and a join step that maps per-test coverage to intent_ids via the header.

Catches the failure mode where a test is added with a valid intent-claim header but its assertions never actually exercise the changed source lines. Stronger than 7f42's (a)+(a+) which only verify manifest registration and symbol reference. Does NOT catch tautological assertions, behavior-irrelevant assertions, or header-lying tests — those require 411b's mutation-kill verification.

## (c) Manifest-claim depth

Per intent_id, count the number of distinct test scenarios registered (counting Rule 7 sibling parameterized cases as separate scenarios). Surfaces intent items that are 'covered' by one test only when the SC implies multiple scenarios should exist (e.g., 'users can export as CSV' likely needs at least empty/single-row/multi-row scenarios).

## Cost-value justification for deferral

The honest assessment from 7f42 brainstorm: (b) closes roughly half the gap from (a) to 411b's catch power at roughly the same engineering cost as 411b itself. 411b's mutation-kill verification strictly dominates (b) for the failure modes (b) doesn't catch (tautological assertions, behavior-irrelevant assertions, header-lying). Best ROI sequence: ship 7f42 (a)+(a+) and 411b first; revisit (b)+(c) once we see real-world catch-rate gaps in the simpler signals.

## Dependencies

Depends on 7f42-e41f (defines the (a)+(a+) base) and 411b-a047 (mutation infrastructure, which may obviate (b) entirely; do not start this epic until 411b's catch-rate is empirically known).

## Out of scope

Anything outside per-test line coverage and manifest-claim depth metrics. Suite-wide aggregation, longitudinal dashboards, telemetry pipelines — separate epics if/when needed.

Refine via /dso:brainstorm when prioritized.
data.title: Test creation calibration (e): intent-anchored line coverage + manifest-claim depth metrics
